samples.prompt: Caleb picked a handful of dandelion puffs. He gave 3 to his mom, another 3 to his sister, 5 to his grandmother, and 2 to his dog. Then, he divided the remaining dandelion puffs equally among his 3 friends. How many dandelion puffs did each friend receive if he originally picked 40 dandelion puffs?
John writes 20 pages a day.  How long will it take him to write 3 books that are 400 pages each?
Jerome is taking a 150-mile bicycle trip. He wants to ride 12 miles for 12 days. How long will he ride on the 13th day to finish his goal?
